author: Marco J Haenssgen
why: Boats on the Mekong at Luang Prabang in sunset light; strong local identity and warm colour for a poster.

author: Leandro De Torres
why: Wide Mekong near Luang Prabang, with a travelling boat and mountainous banks; the river occupies a substantial part of the composition.

author: Etienne Girardet
why: Documented Cái Răng floating market in the Vietnamese Mekong Delta; boats, trading activity and water provide a recognisable alternative to Luang Prabang.
